from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import xarray as xr


class TestConcatResultIndexesKeysHardQA:
    def test_concat_result_indexes_keys_case(self) -> None:
        midx = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
            [["A", "B"], [1, 3]],
            names=["grp", "rank"],
        )
        mcoords = xr.Coordinates.from_pandas_multiindex(midx, "m")

        ds1 = xr.Dataset(
            data_vars={
                "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6], [7, 8]], dtype=np.int64)),
                "noise": ("x", np.array([10, 20], dtype=np.int64)),
            },
            coords={"x": np.array([0, 2], dtype=np.int64)},
        ).assign_coords(mcoords)

        ds2 = xr.Dataset(
            data_vars={
                "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[9, 10], [11, 12], [13, 14], [15, 16]], dtype=np.int64)),
                "noise": ("x", np.array([30, 40], dtype=np.int64)),
            },
            coords={"x": np.array([2, 4], dtype=np.int64)},
        ).assign_coords(mcoords)

        ds3 = xr.Dataset(
            data_vars={
                "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[17, 18], [19, 20], [21, 22], [23, 24]], dtype=np.int64)),
                "noise": ("x", np.array([50, 60], dtype=np.int64)),
            },
            coords={"x": np.array([4, 6], dtype=np.int64)},
        ).assign_coords(mcoords)

        merged = xr.concat(
            [ds1, ds2, ds3],
            dim=pd.Index(["b0", "b1", "b2"], name="batch"),
            data_vars="all",
            coords="different",
            join="outer",
            fill_value=-99,
        )

        assert isinstance(merged, xr.Dataset)
        assert merged.sizes["batch"] == 3
        assert "signal" in merged.data_vars
        assert "noise" in merged.data_vars

import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import xarray as xr
import xarray.core.concat as cc

captured = None

# identify code object
code = cc._dataset_concat.__code__

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global captured
    if event == 'call' and frame.f_code is code:
        return tracer
    if event == 'line' and frame.f_code is code:
        if 'result_indexes' in frame.f_locals:
            ri = frame.f_locals['result_indexes']
            if ri and captured is None:
                captured = sorted(list(ri.keys()))
                # stop tracing once captured
                return None
        return tracer
    return tracer

midx = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
    [["A", "B"], [1, 3]],
    names=["grp", "rank"],
)
mcoords = xr.Coordinates.from_pandas_multiindex(midx, "m")

ds1 = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6], [7, 8]], dtype=np.int64)),
        "noise": ("x", np.array([10, 20], dtype=np.int64)),
    },
    coords={"x": np.array([0, 2], dtype=np.int64)},
).assign_coords(mcoords)

ds2 = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[9, 10], [11, 12], [13, 14], [15, 16]], dtype=np.int64)),
        "noise": ("x", np.array([30, 40], dtype=np.int64)),
    },
    coords={"x": np.array([2, 4], dtype=np.int64)},
).assign_coords(mcoords)

ds3 = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "signal": (("m", "x"), np.array([[17, 18], [19, 20], [21, 22], [23, 24]], dtype=np.int64)),
        "noise": ("x", np.array([50, 60], dtype=np.int64)),
    },
    coords={"x": np.array([4, 6], dtype=np.int64)},
).assign_coords(mcoords)

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    xr.concat(
        [ds1, ds2, ds3],
        dim=pd.Index(["b0", "b1", "b2"], name="batch"),
        data_vars="all",
        coords="different",
        join="outer",
        fill_value=-99,
    )
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

print('CAPTURED', captured)
print('CONCAT_FILE', cc.__file__)
